center_runtime_startup_orchestration.notes: 7-phase startup exists; orchestrator + launcher work; but UDM/UCM/registry stability conditional

websocket_connection_layer.notes: CANONICAL path /ws/device/{device_id} complete; COMPAT paths /ws/android/* complete; legacy /ws/ufo3 disabled; AIP v3 normalisation on ingress

device_registration_handshake.notes: UDM write + local cache update solid; 7 downstream steps (mesh session, runtime session registry, body mesh roles, auto-enrollment) are all try/except silent-degrade

heartbeat_liveness.notes: 30s heartbeat from Android; center handles + UDM heartbeat update; UCM mark_online

offline_queue_reconnect.notes: FIFO, max 50, SharedPreferences persistence, session authority bounding (discardForDifferentSession), reconnect drain implemented

reconnect_continuity_classification.notes: classify_reconnect_outcome -> continuity_resume / new_attachment; runtime_attachment_session_id echoed to client

task_assign_dispatch_center_to_android.notes: task_assign sent via DeviceRouter -> android_bridge -> WS; Android receives + routes to AgentRuntimeBridge or EdgeExecutor; dispatch decision quality depends on UDM accuracy

task_result_truth_chain.notes: 4-step truth chain code exists and is called; BUT all 4 steps are try/except silent-degrade; is_truth_chain_complete=False only prints warning, does not block or retry

task_result_idempotency.notes: durable store check before processing; duplicate suppressed; cross-restart safe

local_edge_execution.notes: EdgeExecutor handles task_assign actions (touch/input/shell/screenshot); depends on Accessibility permission being granted; STATUS_SUCCESS/ERROR/CANCELLED/TIMEOUT mapped

autonomous_goal_execution.notes: Pipeline exists; local_model_inference conditionally available (requires both components up); dependency on grounding/OCR/LLM

goal_result_truth_chain.notes: goal_result handler exists but does NOT call run_task_result_truth_chain; only basic memory backflow

handoff_v2_takeover.notes: Protocol aligned; eligibility assessment exists; actual execution depth in DelegatedTakeoverExecutor depends on local agent capabilities

memory_backflow.notes: Called after truth chain in handle_task_result; try/except so non-blocking; OpenClawd module must be available

acceptance_verdict.notes: No explicit acceptance verdict mechanism; completion = accepted (optimistic). HITL approval routes exist (core/routes/approvals.py) but not wired into task completion chain

governance_active_enforce.notes: Governance config + routes exist; NOT called in task execution chain; passive policy store only

p2p_mesh_coordination.notes: Peer exchange messages handled, body mesh roles registered; full P2P multi-device task coordination not traced to complete closure

federation_multi_center.notes: Federation routes exist; actual multi-instance task routing not traced

observability_telemetry.notes: Prometheus + Grafana configured; runtime_observability_sink emits lifecycle events; Android has GalaxyLogger; not all paths emit structured events

end_to_end_usability.notes: Core link (register->dispatch->execute->result->memory-backflow) can run; truth/acceptance chain has gaps; goal execution depends on local capabilities; no E2E integration tests

critical_gaps.title: Truth chain steps are all try/except silent-degrade
critical_gaps.impact: is_truth_chain_complete=False does not block processing; truth may never close
critical_gaps.fix_direction: Make Step3 (authority_state_update) and Step4 (completion_linkage) hard-fail or retry; propagate incomplete truth to dead-letter queue

critical_gaps.title: Device registration downstream steps all silent-degrade
critical_gaps.impact: Device may be in UDM but absent from runtime_session_registry and body_mesh_registry; affects dispatch decisions
critical_gaps.fix_direction: Make attach_runtime_session and register_session required steps; fail registration if they cannot be completed

critical_gaps.title: goal_result missing truth chain
critical_gaps.impact: goal_result does not go through 4-step truth chain; truth/acceptance asymmetry between task and goal
critical_gaps.fix_direction: Call run_task_result_truth_chain (or dedicated goal_result_truth_chain) in handle_goal_execution_result

critical_gaps.title: No final acceptance / verdict mechanism
critical_gaps.impact: completion = accepted (optimistic); false-positive results not detected
critical_gaps.fix_direction: Add task_acceptance_ledger with explicit verdict states; wire HITL approval routes into completion chain

critical_gaps.title: AutonomousExecutionPipeline local LLM conditional availability not handled
critical_gaps.impact: goal_execution silently degrades when local LLM unavailable; center not notified for LLM-assisted fallback
critical_gaps.fix_direction: Explicit capability_unavailable signal when local LLM is down; center falls back to cloud LLM + notifies Android of strategy

critical_gaps.title: Compat WS path truth chain consistency
critical_gaps.impact: Legacy core-direct clients bypass canonical gateway truth chain handling
critical_gaps.fix_direction: Ensure compat path task_result handler calls same run_task_result_truth_chain as canonical gateway handler

critical_gaps.title: No E2E integration tests
critical_gaps.impact: No machine-verifiable evidence that full chain (register->dispatch->execute->result->truth_chain_complete) works
critical_gaps.fix_direction: Add tests/integration/test_e2e_task_lifecycle.py using real FastAPI WebSocket test client
